!Series_summary = Hashimoto's thyroiditis and papillary thyroid cancer are the most common thyroid disorders. We used spatial transcriptome sequencing (ST-seq) to investigate their potential relationship.
!Series_overall_design = Specimens were collected from patients with Hashimoto's thyroiditis and papillary thyroid cancer and analyzed using ST-seq.
!Series_type = Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
